svg.aria-label: A page read four times close together, then once more after a gap. LFU counts the reads and never fades. LRU resets to 1 at each read and fades, with no build-up. CAST builds up with each read and fades by half every half-life.
svg.text: What a read does to a page's rank, and what time does after
the same reads under each policy: six close together, a long gap, one more
LRU: back to 1 at a read, no build-up
CAST (LRFU): +1 a read, halves every H
